title: BreakGlassSessionChangedPayload
description: Payload of the BreakGlassSessionChanged platform event (class: platform; INV-REQ-896, INV-Q-9119 option A). access-svc emits it for each break-glass unlock (OPEN) and each reseal (SEALED); the authority replica of every other service holds the session from it. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

unlockRef.description: The break-glass unlock the session belongs to.

status.description: Whether the session is open or sealed again.

expiresAt.description: When the session expires; checked locally by the replica.

approvedBy.description: The approvers of the unlock, in order (as UnlockBreakGlassRequest.approvedBy).
